characters.summary: Worthy Captain America combines his peak human conditioning, master shield-fighting, and hand-to-hand combat prowess with the divine power of Mjolnir, allowing him to summon lightning, fly, and enhance his physical strikes to superhuman levels.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to overwhelmingly powerful physical attacks if disarmed
limitations: Requires being deemed worthy to lift Mjolnir
characters.formDifferences: This form grants Captain America the ability to wield Mjolnir, granting him the power of Thor including flight, lightning generation, and enhanced strength.

sources.supports: General overview of Captain America's appearances and abilities in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

notableResults.note: Fought fiercely using Mjolnir and his shield, but was ultimately overpowered by Thanos.

unknowns: Exact limits of the physical enhancement provided by wielding Mjolnir in the MCU.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to dampening technology or magic that interferes with cosmic energy
limitations: Power is tied to her cosmic origin and emotional control

characters.summary: Daredevil is a blind martial arts master whose remaining four senses are enhanced to superhuman levels, allowing him to navigate via echolocation, detect heartbeats, and defeat groups of armed thugs in close quarters.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to overwhelming sensory overload (e.g., high-frequency sounds or intense chemicals)
limitations: Human physical body subject to fatigue and trauma

notableResults.note: Engaged in a brief skirmish before cooperating.

unknowns: Exact limits of radar sense against instantaneous teleportation.

characters.summary: Deadpool is a highly resilient mercenary proficient in dual-wielding firearms and blades, backed by an accelerated healing factor and fourth-wall-breaking awareness.
weaknesses: Mental instability and propensity for distraction
limitations: Regeneration can be taxed by massive trauma or specific dampening elements

sources.supports: Overview of Deadpool's combat style, healing factor, and weaponry.

notableResults.note: Fought brutal stalemates utilizing their mutual healing factors.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses a rapid regenerative healing factor.
Carries extensive firearms and edged weapons.

unknowns: Absolute limit of regeneration if completely vaporized.

characters.summary: Zenpool is a pacifistic, peace-seeking incarnation of Deadpool who renounces lethal violence, seeking to resolve conflicts through meditation and dialogue rather than bloodshed.
weaknesses: Unwillingness to use lethal force against aggressive opponents
limitations: Refuses to attack enemies with lethal intent
characters.formDifferences: Replaces lethal firearms and blades with a pacifistic philosophy and non-violent conflict resolution approach.

sources.supports: General publication history and variant personas of Deadpool including Zenpool.

unknowns: Exact duration and permanence of the Zenpool mindset under extreme provocation.
